name: lin_nilpotent_det_zero
statement: (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (h : A ^ k = 0) : Matrix.det A = 0
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (h : A ^ k = 0), Matrix.det A = 0
informal: A nilpotent real matrix of positive size has determinant 0 — det(A)^k = det(A^k) = det 0 = 0 (size positive), and ℝ has no nilpotents.
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ), A ^ k = 0 → A.det = 0
